BOKE.author_lookup_interpretation: Source-owned literal routes are version-bound candidate witnesses only; no author mapping is applied and no biological or numerical admission is granted.
BOKE.cereal_compatibility: LandClim separates Cerealia-t excluding rye and Secale, whereas2020Cerealia is harmonised jointly. No automatic merge, split, generic grass substitution or full terrestrial denominator follows from label coverage.
BOKE.lookup_rule: Literal exact source labels only. Whitespace candidates are retained separately, not applied. Genus/species, pollen-type and family mappings require a declared source-owned crosswalk and applicability review; no missing RPP, FSP or SE becomes zero.
BOKE.normalization: A Poaceae reference RPP of1 with missing SE supports only its stated nominal reference value; no SD/SE0 is invented. LandClim SD labels and2020compiled-mean SE labels remain distinct.
